name: ask_user
description: Ask the owner a question that only he can answer, and wait for his spoken answer.

name: say
description: Tell the owner something.

text.description: What to say; at most 600 characters.

name: finish
description: End the task as done. Kestrel checks the evidence; a claim without it fails.

summary.description: What was done; at most 300 characters.

evidence.description: What shows that the task is done: elements of the newest observation, or the steps of data tools.

target.description: The number of an element in the newest observation.

step.description: The step of a data tool's result, which its result line names: Result (step 5) is step 5.

checked.description: For a checkable element: whether it should be checked.

percent.description: For a slider: the percent that it should now show.

signature.description: The kind of task, such as messaging.send_text.viber.

notes.description: Notes for the next time in an app, at most 3 per app. A note is a path of fixed verbs and quoted labels joined by arrows, such as: open "Chats" → tap "New chat". The verbs are open, tap, long press, type into and scroll, each with the label of the element that it acts on, and back; at most 8 steps. Kestrel keeps only a path whose labels your own steps acted on.

name: fail
description: End the task because it cannot be done.

name: remember
description: Ask the owner to remember a fact, such as an alias.

name: forget
description: Ask the owner to forget a fact.

name: set_slider
description: Put a slider of the newest observation at a percent of its range. Kestrel reads the value back.

target.description: The number of an element in the newest observation.

percent.description: Where to put the slider, in percent of its range: 0 is its lowest and 100 its highest.
